Paper Name: Design & simulation of hydrogen based hybrid green power system using sea water for Cox's Bazar
NOTES: Kabir & Matin Bhuiyan (2017), Cogent Engineering 4:1347029. HOMER Pro simulation for Kolatoli, Cox's Bazar, Bangladesh. System is entirely green (PV + Wind + H2 electrolysis + Gas Turbine Generator). No inverter used (authors explicitly state the system provides pure AC without power electronics). No fuel cell - gas turbine generator used instead for peak load. No battery storage. COE reported as overall 'cost of energy' $0.178/kWh (Table 15); individual component costs: PV $0.039/kWh, Wind $0.04/kWh. LCOE not separately reported; used overall COE in LCOE field with note. No discount/interest rate stated. No O&M costs broken out individually (only annualized capital costs in Table 15). Fuel curve intercept/slope given in L/hr/kW for H2 gas turbine (0.01400 and 0.0420). H2_LHV from page 8 text = 120 MJ/kg. Life of DG given as both 25,000 hours (Table 6) and 14 years operational life (Table 12). eta_PV=40% from Lipu (2013) citation (page 6). No grid connection (off-grid/islanded). LPSP not explicitly reported. No emission factors reported (system is zero-emission green H2).
